elements.element: If the agreement does not use automatic renewal, any renewal must occur only by mutual written agreement.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause uses automatic renewal, so the condition for the mutual-written-agreement alternative is absent.

elements.element: If the agreement uses automatic renewal, each renewal term must be 12 months.
elements.evidence: The operative language provides for automatic renewal for additional “1-year terms.”

elements.element: If the agreement uses automatic renewal, Customer must be able to prevent renewal by giving 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: The clause states that renewal occurs “unless Customer gives 30 days' notice of non-renewal.”

elements.element: If the agreement uses automatic renewal, Vendor must remind Customer 60 days before each renewal.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence requires Kubient to notify Customer “at least 60 days before the end of each term” of the upcoming automatic renewal.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that “any price increase for a renewal term shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%.”
The clause provides that the Agreement “will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms.”

elements.element: The required non-renewal notice window must be no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: Customer may prevent renewal on 30 days' notice, which is within the maximum 60-day window.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed 5%.
elements.evidence: The operative cap is the lesser of CPI and 3%, which cannot exceed 3% and therefore cannot exceed 5%.

result.reason: The redline satisfies the preferred automatic-renewal route and, consequently, the fallback. It adds only the required Customer opt-out, Vendor reminder, and price cap while leaving unrelated termination rights intact. Drafting is operative and directionally clear, though quality is reduced because “CPI” is undefined and the new 30-day non-renewal right sits alongside a separate 90-day post-Initial-Term termination right without expressly distinguishing their effects, which may create interpretive uncertainty.
